scripts.build: vite build -c vite.main.config.ts && vite build -c vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.build:native: cd native/sparkle-bridge && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.prepackage: pnpm --filter @app/web build && (test -f ../web/dist/index.html || (echo 'web/dist/index.html missing after build' && exit 1))
scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm rebuild-native && pnpm build:native && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64
